github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Always generate Git commit messages in Conventional Commits format: type(scope): description. Use English and lowercase. Allowed types: feat, fix, refactor, docs, style, test, perf, chore, ci. Choose the scope based on the changed module. Write a concise and meaningful description using imperative verbs. Do not use emojis or end with a period. Keep the first line under 72 characters. Never invent changes.
